description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents… “30Yay!” in Seagrove Beach. Welcome to a stunning coastal retreat with a private heated pool, spa, and spacious fenced backyard—your personal oasis for family fun or relaxing in the sun. With 5 luxurious suites, there’s space for everyone to recharge. A short stroll (4-min walk) takes you to the sugar-white sands of the Gulf, and with 4 bikes included, you can explore the beauty of 30A with ease. Ready to turn your dream getaway into reality? Learn more below… *** HIGHLIGHTS *** 4-Min Walk to the Beach – Enjoy effortless access to sun, sand, and sea, perfect for morning strolls or sunset views.Private Heated Pool & Spa – Indulge in ultimate relaxation, whether soaking in the spa or taking a refreshing dip in the pool.Spacious Fenced Backyard – Gather with family and friends in the outdoor dining area, fire up the grill, or unwind in the cozy lounging spaces.3 King Suites with En-suite Bathrooms – Experience luxury and privacy with beautifully designed suites perfect for restful nights.7 Bikes Included – Explore the charming 30A area on two wheels, from scenic paths to local hotspots.Wrap-around Balcony with Pool Views – Feel the tranquility as you sip your coffee or wine, overlooking the serene pool below.Close to Seaside, Watersound, and Upscale Dining – Immerse yourself in the vibrant coastal life, with boutique shops, fine dining, and picturesque communities just minutes away. Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests: “The property was exactly as described. Clean, spacious, and just a short walk to the beach. Perfect for large groups!” – Kevin G.“Great location and plenty of space for our family! Would highly recommend for a relaxing stay near the beach.” – Amir R.“Beautiful home with amazing pool and backyard. We loved the included bikes and how close it was to the beach!” – Maegan K. *** LIVING AREA *** Step into the stunning open-concept living space, thoughtfully designed for both comfort and connection. Expansive floor-to-ceiling windows flood the room with natural light and provide breathtaking views of the backyard oasis. A plush seating area and large-screen TV create an inviting space for family gatherings, movie nights, or quiet relaxation. Expansive windows with panoramic pool viewsLuxurious, cozy seating and a smart TV for entertainmentSeamless flow into the modern kitchen and dining areas, perfect for hosting and everyday living *** KITCHEN AND DINING *** The upscale kitchen is perfect for home chefs, featuring navy cabinetry, granite countertops, and premium appliances. Gather around the island or enjoy meals in the spacious dining area. Fully equipped kitchen with high-end appliancesGranite counters and ample cabinet storageDining table seating 8, plus 4 bar stools at the island *** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS *** Transform your backyard into a private oasis, featuring a luxurious heated pool and spa that invites you to relax in style. The covered patio is designed for both comfort and fun, offering a dining area, cozy lounge seating, and an outdoor TV—perfect for lively gatherings or quiet evenings. Luxurious private heated pool and spa for ultimate relaxationElegant covered patio with a dining table, plush lounge seating, and a flat-screen TVOutdoor grill perfect for family barbecues and entertainingExpansive yard ideal for games, sunbathing, or simply unwinding in the sun *** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS *** 1st Floor: Luxurious King Suite: Features a king-size bed, private patio access, spacious walk-in closet, flat-screen TV, and a spa-like En-suite complete with a soaking tub, double vanity, and walk-in shower for ultimate relaxation.Convenient Half Bath: Perfectly situated near the common areas for easy access during gatherings. 2nd Floor: King Suite 1: Enjoy a king-size bed, a private balcony with stunning pool views, and an elegant En-suite with dual sinks and a walk-in shower.King Suite 2: Offers a king-size bed, access to two balconies, and a stylish En-suite featuring a single vanity and a walk-in shower.Fun Bunk Room: Equipped with two twin-over-twin bunk beds, ideal for kids or extra guests looking for a cozy space.Queen Guest Room: Includes a queen-size bed and access to a shared hall bathroom, complete with dual sinks and a tub/shower combo for added convenience. *** LOCATION & COMMUNITY *** Located in the heart of Seagrove Beach, “30Yay!” is your ideal 30A escape, blending relaxation, adventure, and coastal charm. From sun-soaked beaches to boutique shopping and mouthwatering dining, everything you need for the perfect getaway is just moments away. Eastern Lake Beach Access (4-Min Walk) – Step into paradise with soft, powdery white sand and serene, crystal-clear waters just a short stroll from your door.Café Thirty-A & Old Florida Fish House (4-Min Drive) – Treat your taste buds to upscale dining or savor fresh coastal classics at these iconic 30A restaurants.Greenway Station (2-Min Drive) – Discover casual dining and shopping options within perfect proximity in Seagrove Beach.Seaside Beach (10-Min Drive) – Dive into the vibrant beach town vibe with charming boutiques, local artistry, and gourmet food options that make Seaside a must-visit destination. *** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW *** Spacious Driveway Parking for Up to 3 SUVs!Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be purchased separately.Please note there is active construction take place in front of this property. We do not have a completion date at this time.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Waiver required to get access to the 4 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.There is an active Google doorbell camera at the front door *** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***
